subject: english
question:
Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose 'No improvement' as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.

The effect of the changes __was unexpected__.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the singular form of the verb 'was' is correct.
 
• The subject **'effect'** is singular, and therefore, the verb **'was'** is **correctly used in its singular form.**
 
• There is** no grammatical error** in the sentence as it** correctly follows the subject-verb agreement rule.**

Hence, the correct sentence is **"*The effect of the changes was unexpected*."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• When the subject of a sentence is** singular,** the verb must also be **singular.** Similarly, when the **subject **is plural, the verb must be** plural**.

 
 
• **Example:** *The cat **runs** fast.* (singular subject and singular verb)
 
• **Example:** *The cats **run** fast.* (plural subject and plural verb)
